items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez is returning after about a year outside the Octagon following time spent in a Mexican jail cell.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez has spent some time in a Mexican jail cell, and he is making his comeback return after, I don't know, about a year outside of the Yakagon.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez will likely suffer from ring rust due to flying across the world and not getting great training while in jail.
items.quote: So, he's gonna really probably have some ring rust compared to his previous fights.

items.claim: Uros Medic has knockout power to finish Daniel Rodriguez.
items.quote: Ro Magic, he definitely has the knockout power to get Daniel Rodriguez out of there.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez has durability concerns at 39 years old, having been knocked out and submitted previously.
items.quote: We have seen him knocked out. We have seen him submitted before and especially at 39 years old. I don't think that durability is going to get any better

items.claim: Uros Medic has chin and durability concerns after nearly being flatlined by Gilbert Urbina and others.
items.quote: I do have concerns for the chin of Ro Medic as well... nearly flatlined against Gilbert Orbina

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is taking the fight on short notice and flying across the world.
items.quote: Navajo Sterling is taking this fight on short notice. He's flying across the world.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz had an entire training camp to prepare for this matchup.
items.quote: Yan Blakovich has had an entire training camp to prepare for this matchup.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling tends to slow down a bit later in fights when grappling gets extended.
items.quote: in some of his fights, he has slowed down a bit when the grappling gets extended.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz has great overall durability traditionally, though he got hurt against Bogdan Guskov.
items.quote: notoriously Jan has had great overall durability, you know, but he did look a little bit worse in that fight against Bogn Guskov where he did get hurt.
